title: X-Fifteen Proxy TC-11

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Shoei X-Fifteen Proxy TC-11 is designed to deliver razor-sharp aerodynamics in a chin-on-tank tuck, purpose-built for riders demanding uncompromising high-speed aerodynamic stability and track-certified protection. Built around a Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell weighing 1402g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~92 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.06 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

product_details.description: The X-Fifteen is a true race-bred helmet, developed in MotoGP.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for aggressive track tuck; features a narrow chin bar and extended rear coverage for aerodynamics. Best suited for riders with an oval head shape.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced Integrated Matrix Plus (AIM+) 6-layer organic fiber and fiberglass composite shell paired with CWR-F2 3D injection-molded visor with Pinlock EVO lens inserts and vortex generators along the shield edges. The interior utilizes Dual-layer multi-density EPS with internal cooling channels and 3D Max-Dry custom cheek pad fitment with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Shoei X-Fifteen Proxy TC-11: combining Japan 🇯🇵 craftsmanship with CWR-F2 3D injection-molded visor with Pinlock EVO lens inserts and vortex generators along the shield edges and Dual-layer multi-density EPS with internal cooling channels and 3D Max-Dry custom cheek pad fitment. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Shoei X-Fifteen Proxy TC-11: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Shoei X-Fifteen Proxy TC-11. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner with emergency quick-release cheek pads (EQRS) for swift removal by first responders.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.

Lightweight shell construction reduces neck strain on long rides
Plush, fully removable and washable antimicrobial cheek liners
real_world_cons: Snug race-contour cheek pads require 2-3 rides for break-in
Premium price point reflecting top-tier safety certifications
qualitative_intelligence.editorial_verdict: The Shoei X-Fifteen Proxy TC-11 is a benchmark Homologation FIM Track Race helmet, engineered to deliver uncompromised safety (ECE 22.06, DOT Certified, FIM FRHPhe-01 Homologated, SHARP 5-Star Safety Rating) and all-day acoustic comfort for serious riders.

introduction: Positioned in Shoei's Track / Race lineup, the X-Fifteen Proxy TC-11 brings Japanese engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Shoei X-Fifteen Proxy TC-11 represents Shoei's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~92 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Track / Race helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Shoei X-Fifteen Proxy TC-11 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
